official_activation_status_source: Read scoring_enabled for the exact current rule ID and digest from the live class server. Activation is a separate operator record, not a change to this immutable package or its rule.
team_registration: Automatic first-use team name and shared-password sign-in. The supplied client stores a separate device credential outside Git and reuses it for results and diagnostics.
team_identity_scope: Self-registered team access. Possession of the agreed shared password is not verification of GitHub membership or university identity.

student_naming.solo: Own student ID for the private repository and leaderboard name
student_naming.group: All member IDs sorted ascending and joined with hyphens for one shared private repository and leaderboard name

student_repository_visibility: one private shared repository per team
contribution_evidence: Each member uses their own account to commit and push. Present their actual contribution using the shared repository history.
public_leaderboard_privacy: Results only. Each student ID is masked to its last four digits in public names. Public board responses omit full team identities and run metadata. Full-ID sign-in and stored records stay unchanged. Other teams cannot access design inputs, joint paths, full receipts or diagnostics.
safe_supplied_file_updates: check/apply/status/rollback with official release hashes, backups and preservation of student work

elapsed_time_policy.legacy_wall_limit_argument: accepted but ignored with a notice
elapsed_time_policy.manual_Ctrl_C: Stops the owned run and preserves available logs. Incomplete runs cannot rank.
elapsed_time_policy.other_constraints: Fixed geometry, joints, control, contact, spill, support, simulation deadlines and memory checks remain in force. Operational network and cleanup timeouts are not computation limits.

independent_arm_workflow.shared_boundary: Agree on layout, support XY and peer/home commands before independent work. Regenerate affected plans after shared input changes.
independent_arm_workflow.merge: Checks exact required arms, compatible inputs, provenance, geometry, edges and saved times. Does not call RRT, IK or a timing hook and does not retime trajectories.
independent_arm_workflow.practice_scope: Selected approach, automatic pick, carry, automatic release and rest from a fresh nominal support boundary. All robots and geometry remain present.
independent_arm_workflow.competition: A new merged whole-scene five-bead review must pass actual handoffs and completion.

current_pc_validation.native_motion_scope: Exact archived joint paths and edge times, newly CPU-validated and merged under the current five-bead source. The fresh RRT solutions have CPU validation only.

native_measurements.timing_scope: Whole-command elapsed and external phase-publication windows are distinct. Windows include observed polling uncertainty, are not isolated solver costs and are not added to whole-command elapsed. Shared initialization is not separately measured.

current_pc_validation.timing_scope: One Genesis command at a time, reused shared caches. Actual elapsed observations only. No cold-cache, equal-speed or isolated solver benchmark claim.

optional_visual_export.scope: Own saved whole or standalone arm plan. Native practice exports recorded states. CPU geometry preview does not qualify physical transport.
optional_visual_export.verification_limit: Full video/WebM encoding and download were not tested in this scoped validation.
optional_visual_export.verification_scope: Genuine current-source Higher whole and arm_2 five-bead previews matched recorded states and passed the supplied parser. Actual Edge UI load, bounded playback, cup-interior view and PNG download passed.

delivery_scope: English README, supplied API/run/arm guides and Outline. Existing map, submission deadlines and grading retained. No PPT or LMS update is claimed.
release_scope: Current five-bead CPU validation on all three complexities and representative Higher full/arm_2 bead physics on the current PC. Lower and Moderate full five-bead native runs and GTX 1660 SUPER remain unverified. Live activation and HTTPS verification are separate deployment records.

historical_release.scope: Historical three-bead records and immutable rules remain under their original generation. The unpublished three-bead term_v5 candidate is not activated or relabelled as five-bead evidence.
